newsitem.title: USA: California lawmakers form panel for welfare reform.
newsitem.headline: California lawmakers form panel for welfare reform.

text.p: Leaders of the California Legislature on Thursday said they would form a special committee to develop welfare reform measures.
"We have a monumental task before us," said state Assembly Speaker Cruz Bustamante. "Our aim is a welfare reform plan that is cost-effective, fair and humane."
The 18-member conference committee will consist of six Senate Democrats, six Assembly Democrats, three Senate Republicans and three Assembly Republicans.
The conference committee would develop legislation to reform the state welfare system in response to new federal rules.
The committee's proposals would then be taken up by the state Assembly and Senate.
